reddit.title: Significant Performance Improvements in Flowing Water Mechanics
reddit.body: We've made some exciting optimizations to the way flowing water is handled in Provincia! Now, drying a single cell no longer requires rescanning the entire map. This change has reduced the script time for a 64×64 flowing lake from about 20 ms to just 12 ms, all while maintaining the same depth levels. Learn more about the technical details and how it impacts gameplay here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost

steam.title: Performance Enhancements for Flowing Water in Provincia
steam.body: We're excited to share that we've made significant performance enhancements to flowing water mechanics in Provincia. The script time for a 64×64 lake has been reduced from around 20 ms to 12 ms, thanks to optimizations that limit rescanning to only necessary cells. This means smoother gameplay and a more enjoyable experience. Read more about these changes here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
